lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice adding one simple personal detail with som.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Friendly conversation about family, friends, and where people live or work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a little more detail about a person without making a long story.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk briefly about a sibling, friend, partner, or colleague and add one simple detail about where that person lives or works.

main_focus.name: simple som detail after a person
main_focus.description: Use som to add one basic identifying detail about a person in present tense.
model_examples: Jag har en syster som bor i Uppsala.
Erik har en vän som jobbar i Malmö.
Anna känner en kollega som pratar svenska.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a simple som clause naturally 2-3 times, with short surrounding sentences.

useful_chunks: Jag har en syster som bor i Uppsala.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use personal vocabulary warmly and simply, with one extra detail where useful.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks a simple question about family or friends.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention one or two people and add a short som detail about each.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react politely and close the personal topic lightly.

target_complexity.repetition: use only a few clear som details so the structure stays approachable

focus: which family member or friend is mentioned
where that person lives or works
how the other speaker responds to the personal detail

sentence_focus: one sentence with a person plus som bor
one sentence with a person plus som jobbar
one sentence with min or din
